channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Tyson Chandler | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Tyson Chandler from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Isaiah Hartenstein on Tyson Chandler
item.description:
Hartenstein shared his past with reporters after training camp on Thursday.

“I had to learn it. I feel like, especially coming in as a rookie, I probably wasn’t talking as much as I should. A big guy [who helped me] with that was Tyson Chandler,”

Isaiah Hartenstein on Tyson Chandler, Oct 4, 2024. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Corey Brewer on Dirk Nowitzki, Jason Kidd, Tyson Chandler, Shawn Marion, Jason Terry, DeShawn Stevenson
item.description:
Corey Brewer:

“So for us, it was like 'alright, they're disrespecting us. And you gotta realize, we had a lot of great players on that team. We had Shawn Marion, Dirk Nowitzki, Jason Kidd, Jason Terry, DeShawn Stevenson, Brandon Haywood. We had Tyson Chandler, the big anchor back there. We had a good team, so we felt disrespected and I think that's what we took into the Finals. If you're going to disrespect us, we're going to show you that we're not to be disrespected.”

Corey Brewer on Dirk Nowitzki, Jason Kidd, Tyson Chandler, Shawn Marion, Jason Terry, DeShawn Stevenson, Apr 2, 2021. Source: CBSSports.com.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Tyson Chandler
item.description:
Mike D'Antoni on the addition of Tyson Chandler:

“He's just a really classy, no-nonsense, great guy in the locker room. I had him in New York and I've been trying to get him for the last 6 years since he's been a free agent.”

Mike D'Antoni on Tyson Chandler, Jul 19, 2019. Source: Twitter @SalmanAliNBA.

item.title: Richaun Holmes on Tyson Chandler
item.description:
Now Phoenix will need somebody new to take on that vocal presence, after the organization and Chandler officially reached an agreement Sunday to buy out the majority of the $13.6 million remaining on his contract.

“(Chandler) really just commands a lot of attention, a lot of respect,”

Richaun Holmes on Tyson Chandler, Nov 5, 2018. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Deandre Ayton on Tyson Chandler
item.description:
“We have the talent, we’re young, we can run. Our vets can help us. I can’t wait to see Tyson Chandler to really tell me the ropes on how to defend the post and how to talk to refs certain ways, even if you’re mad or fatigued. I just want him to teach me that.”

Deandre Ayton on Tyson Chandler, Jul 10, 2018. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Tyson Chandler
item.description:
Mark Cuban on his current relationship with Chandler, who was upset at how the Mavericks handled his free agency this summer:

“We actually texted each other a couple times this week. We got along great. Basically I told him I'm sorry. Not because of what happened, more because I didn't get a chance to see him after the game. I was looking for him but I didn't get the chance to talk to him. So I texted him. We went back and forth. I think we've got a good relationship.”

Mark Cuban on Tyson Chandler, Oct 28, 2015. Source: Fort Worth Star-Telegram.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Tyson Chandler
item.description:
Dwain Price:Mark Cuban on Tyson Chandler:

“He has a right to be upset. I said it before, if I were him I’d be upset.”

Mark Cuban on Tyson Chandler, Oct 22, 2015. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Tyson Chandler
item.description:
Tim Cato:Mark Cuban on Tyson Chandler:

“He has every right to be mad. If I were him, I'd be mad, too.”

Mark Cuban on Tyson Chandler, Oct 21, 2015. Source: Twitter @tim_cato.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Tyson Chandler
item.description:
Earl K. Sneed:Rick Carlisle:

“[Tyson Chandler] is truly one of the all-time great Mavericks in history. There's just no doubt about it.”

Rick Carlisle on Tyson Chandler, Oct 21, 2015. Source: Twitter @EarlKSneed.

item.title: Eric Bledsoe on Tyson Chandler
item.description:
Paul Coro:Eric Bledsoe:

“Tyson (Chandler) is the main guy and whatever he's got to say, I'm going to listen.”

Eric Bledsoe on Tyson Chandler, Sep 28, 2015. Source: Twitter @paulcoro.

item.title: Mike Woodson on Tyson Chandler
item.description:
Ian Begley:Mike Woodson said if he wasn't fired as #Knicks coach

“I probably would've pushed to keep Tyson (Chandler) & keep that core group together.”

Mike Woodson on Tyson Chandler, Mar 25, 2015. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: Charles Barkley on Tyson Chandler
item.description:
Barkley said on The Mike Lupica Show.

“He is the most important player. I mean obviously Carmelo (Anthony) is important but Tyson Chandler -- I am a big Tyson Chandler fan -- without him, they are in serious trouble.”

Charles Barkley on Tyson Chandler, Nov 6, 2013. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Jim Boeheim on Tyson Chandler
item.description:
When asked if Anthony can lead the Knicks as constructed to an NBA title, Boeheim told the paper:

“Not on that team. He did what he can do. He played very well the final game. Everybody’s killing him but Tyson Chandler just didn’t try to catch the ball. He threw him the ball and Tyson Chandler went like this”

Jim Boeheim on Tyson Chandler, May 21, 2013. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Jim Boeheim on Carmelo Anthony, Tyson Chandler
item.description:
“He did what he can do. He played very well the final game. Everybody's killing him but Tyson Chandler just didn't try to catch the ball. He threw him the ball and Tyson Chandler went like this (Boeheim dodged in a chair in his office in the Carmelo K. Anthony Center). He was wide open. He should have been looking for the ball right here. Kenyon Martin should have been looking for the ball. They both went like this (Boeheim dodged again). Carmelo gets turnovers and the announcers aren't smart enough to even think, 'Well, the guy should try to catch the ball.'”

Jim Boeheim on Carmelo Anthony, Tyson Chandler, May 20, 2013. Source: The Post-Standard.

item.title: Kobe Bryant on Tyson Chandler
item.description:
“Not other than Tyson Chandler. I'm the best post player on this team, period. Tyson Chandler is not in that conversation.”

Kobe Bryant on Tyson Chandler, Aug 9, 2012. Source: USA Today.

item.title: Larry Riley on Tyson Chandler
item.description:
Then, Stephen Curry said he got assurances from Warriors decision-makers that he'll be the one tossing lobs to Chandler.

“I'll tell you that Tyson Chandler is a guy we'd really love to have here in the Bay Area,”

Larry Riley on Tyson Chandler, Dec 8, 2011. Source: San Francisco Chronicle.
